all_of.section: Exposure / Clear water can be unsafe
all_of.quote: Water containing germs that can make you sick—including bacteria, viruses, and parasites—sometimes looks clean.

all_of.section: Key points
all_of.quote: If you are not sure whether the water you are using is safe to drink, treat it to remove germs.

all_of.section: Overview
all_of.quote: If you are not sure if water is safe to drink, boil it or use another method to remove germs.

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Treat your water / Boil
all_of.quote: To kill germs, bring clear water to a rolling boil for 1 minute.

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Treat your water / Boil
all_of.quote: At elevations above 6,500 feet, boil for 3 minutes.

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Treat your water
all_of.quote: You cannot make water containing harmful chemicals, toxins, or radioactive materials safe by boiling or disinfecting it.

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Treat your water
all_of.quote: Use bottled water or a different source of water instead.

all_of.section: Reduce your risk of getting lost / If you get lost
all_of.quote: Don’t keep going into unfamiliar terrain hoping to find your way.

all_of.section: Reduce your risk of getting lost / If you get lost
all_of.quote: Stop and assess the situation.

all_of.section: Reduce your risk of getting lost / If you get lost
all_of.quote: Unless you are certain of the way out, stay where you are.

all_of.section: Reduce your risk of getting lost / If you get lost
all_of.quote: Make yourself and your group safe and comfortable – get warm, eat and drink, make a shelter, use first aid if needed.

all_of.section: Reduce your risk of getting lost / If you get lost
all_of.quote: Call for help and make yourself visible.

all_of.quote: Trykk bandasje eller reint tøy direkte mot blødinga og bruk fingrane til å presse mot såret for å redusere blødinga mest mogleg.

all_of.section: Førstehjelp ved ytre blødingar / Kva kan du gjere sjølv? / Bandasjar med press mot blødinga:

all_of.section: Slik legger du en person i sideleie

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Bury your poop
all_of.quote: Aim to bury your poop deep in the soil, at least 8 inches, and at least 200 feet away from lakes, rivers, and other natural waters.

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Bury your poop
all_of.quote: Make sure to bury poop downstream from where you or others collect water.

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Wash your hands
all_of.quote: Wash your hands before handling food, eating, and after using the toilet.

all_of.section: Prevention steps and strategies / Wash your hands
all_of.quote: If soap and water are not available, use a hand sanitizer that contains at least 60% alcohol .

all_of.quote: When you arrive at a river crossing, look for the warning signs of an unsafe river.

all_of.section: Know the signs of an unsafe river
all_of.quote: If any are present, do not attempt a crossing.

all_of.section: Know the signs of an unsafe river
all_of.quote: Murky: the water is discoloured, often brown.

all_of.section: Do not cross if there is any doubt
all_of.quote: Do not cross if:

all_of.section: Do not cross if there is any doubt
all_of.quote: the river is flooded.

all_of.section: Do not cross if there is any doubt

all_of.section: Do not cross if there is any doubt
all_of.quote: If in doubt? Stay out.

all_of.section: Be ready to wait or turn back
all_of.quote: You may encounter a dangerous river and need to turn back or wait until the river is safe to cross.

all_of.section: Call for help early
all_of.quote: If you or someone else is in a life-threatening situation, set your beacon off .

all_of.section: Call for help early
all_of.quote: Situations can deteriorate rapidly.

all_of.section: Call for help early
all_of.quote: The sooner you activate it, the faster help can be sent to your location.

all_of.section: Call for help early
all_of.quote: If you are unsure about when to activate the beacon, it is better to activate it and get help.

all_of.quote: Faretegn (også kalt alarmtegn) er naturens måte å fortelle deg at det er skredfare i området.

all_of.section: Husk å lage reserveplaner.
all_of.quote: Dersom faretegn og skredfarevurderinger forteller deg at den planlagte turen bør endres så er dette en enklere beslutning å ta dersom du og turfølget ditt allerede har planlagt og snakket sammen om dette.
